name: CogBench
description: CogBench is a benchmark designed to rigorously evaluate the Multimodal Retrieval Augmented Generation Planning (MRAG Planning) task. It facilitates lightweight integration of agentic plug-and-play frameworks like CogPlanner with resource-efficient multimodal large language models, focusing on effective information seeking, query reformulation, and response generation.
reputation: A very new benchmark with limited community adoption so far, mainly of interest to multimodal agent and planning research.
notes: Evaluates MRAG Planning task; supports parallel and sequential modeling paradigms.
